facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-3100 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-3100 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 6 September 2018 a potential incident was recorded on SG-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
